about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in a chilling nightmare where the darkest corners of the past come to life to haunt you. This is a tense first-person psychological horror game that transports you to the heart of an abandoned police station. This is a place that the city authorities are preparing to demolish, but its walls hold too many untold stories and unbearable human despair.

A DEEP DIVE INTO THE PAST:

The old station is not just a collection of rooms, but a living archive of pain and injustice. As you make your way through the rotting corridors, dusty offices, gloomy holding cells, and sinister basement, you will stumble upon fragments of long-forgotten stories. Each document you find, each record, is a new piece of the puzzle that slowly but surely reveals the shocking truth about the tragedy that took place here decades ago.

SURVIVAL AND INVESTIGATION MECHANICS:

Interactive environment: Explore every corner of the site. Look for keys, notes, and items that will help you progress.

UNCOVER THE CURSE AND BRING PEACE:

Your task is not just to escape. You must gather all the pieces of the case, understand the true reason for the murder of Abigail Brown and the fate of her little daughter Lily. Only by uncovering the whole truth and returning the symbol of their bond—a teddy bear—to the site of the most terrible tragedy can you break the cycle of suffering and bring peace to the restless soul.

Prepare for a night you will never forget and begin your last shift.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3570K or AMD FX-8310
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 670 / GeForce GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon HD 7870
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: INTEL CORE I7-8700K or AMD RYZEN 5 3600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 1080Ti or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
